name: Vikunja Todos
author: jsongerber
description: Quick access to your Vikunja todos.

barWidget.description: Shows your next todo in the bar and your open todos on click

schema.label: Instance URL
schema.description: Base URL of your Vikunja instance, e.g. https://vikunja.example.com

schema.label: Show todos without a due date
schema.description: Include tasks that have no due date.

schema.label: Show next task title in the bar
schema.description: Display the next task's title in the bar; when off, only a compact icon is shown.

schema.label: Sync interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the todo list refreshes automatically.
